description: ENTER statement (X3.23-1985 Nucleus: ENTER language-name [routine-name]) - other-language entry, NOT PROVIDED by this implementation (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.5 leaves it to the implementor; GnuCOBOL refuses it; kb/Work PB5308), so a declined row: refused by name at 85 (COBOL7240) and removed by ISO 2002 (the operands are SYSTEM-names, deliberately not cobolWord - ENTER COBOL parses at 85 and COBOL is an '85 reserved word, so the statement can be refused by name).
citation: obsolete '85 other-language entry deleted by ISO 2002 (§2023:8.9 absence); not provided at 85 (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.5, the implementor's option; docs/conformance/3.7.1); VCR Table 7 row 7.16
